brief.summary_1line: Maricha recounts his first encounter with the young Rama, whose arrow hurled him into the sea and convinced him of Rama’s terrifying power.

image_candidates.scene_text: The youthful Rama in simple garments draws his bow in Vishwamitra’s forest hermitage as the demon Maricha charges toward the sacrificial altar.
Rama’s arrow strikes Maricha and hurls the massive demon through the sky across a hundred yojanas toward the distant sea.
Maricha, recalling the future, envisions Lanka’s jeweled palaces burning under a storm of Rama’s arrows.
